name: Han Liu
bio: Han Liu (韓疁; Han Liu; fl. c. 1200) was a writer of ci, the Chinese song lyrics composed to set tunes, in the Song dynasty.
The single ci here is from the chinese-poetry dataset of Zhu Zumou's 1924 anthology Three Hundred Song Lyrics (宋词三百首), in simplified characters, with the tune name as title.

poems.title: 高阳台 (Gao yang tai)
poems.author: Han Liu
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
频听银签，重燃绛蜡，年华衮衮惊心。
饯旧迎新，能消几刻光阴。
老来可惯通宵饮，待不眠、还怕寒侵。
掩清尊。
多谢梅花，伴我微吟。
邻娃已试春妆了，更蜂腰簇翠，燕股横金。
勾引东风，也知芳思难禁。
朱颜那有年年好，逞艳游、赢取如今。
恣登临。
残雪楼台，迟日园林。
